title: superclaude runs from a copy of itself
intention: superclaude.py finds the repo and its own scripts from where the repo is, not from where its file sits, so a copy laid in an instance bin runs as the symlink does, and a copy that can find no repo says so and stops.
why: Measured 2026-11-24 by akiendell_cc_0 on akiendell (b0931d04a912's scratch box): bin/cairn run through MSYS bash laid devices/superclaude/0/bin/superclaude as a COPY (is_symlink False, resolve() stayed in the scratch bin), and superclaude.py died "can't open file .../devices/superclaude/0/bin/scripts/memory_link.py": cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py:147 builds the script path from _FILE.parent. With MSYS=winsymlinks:nativestrict the same run laid a symlink and the dry run exited 0. Read on akiendelllinux (cairn 0ba928548): cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py:37 is `_REPO = _FILE.parents[3]`, the same derivation from the file's own place; imports survived the copy only because dispatch sets PYTHONPATH to the repo (bin/cairn.py near :164) (inference, labelled as such by akiendell: the floor path at :138 breaks too). A second site makes copies: bin/cairn.py _wire_link's shutil.copy2 fallback (:198, :206). Recorded at ~/.cairn/devices/cc/0/measurements/superclaude-copy-2026-11-24.md.
traces_to: Law 7 (a failure is loud at its diagnostic surface, not a missing-file traceback three hops away) and CP6 (a copy where a link was meant is the world being unsafe; the script survives it).
how: In cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py: _REPO is the first of _FILE.parents[3], then each PYTHONPATH entry, that holds cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py; none holds it: print 'superclaude: cannot find the cairn repo (ran from <_FILE>; set PYTHONPATH to the repo)' to stderr, exit 2. Every path built from _FILE.parent (memory_link at :147, any other scripts/ path) is built from _REPO/cairn/devices/cc instead. Red-first proof copies superclaude.py into a scratch dir and runs it with --dry-run.

clauses.claim: a copy of cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py in a scratch dir, run with PYTHONPATH set to the repo and --dry-run, exits 0 and no stderr line names a path under the scratch dir
the same copy run with PYTHONPATH empty exits 2 and its stderr says it cannot find the cairn repo
no path in cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py is built from _FILE.parent; cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_superclaude_wire.py and cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_superclaude_runs_from_python.py pass unchanged

decisions.text: D1: _REPO is searched for, not assumed; scripts paths come from _REPO; the no-repo case exits 2 loudly.
D2: cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_superclaude_runs_from_a_copy_of_itself.py, one PROVES key per clause, the copy and scratch dirs under the tester's scratch door.

out: bin/cairn.py _wire_link's shutil.copy2 fallback (the second site that lays copies): its own ticket on bin if a copy must be announced or refused
MSYS bash's ln -s laying a copy (winsymlinks): a host-seam setting, not code
every other script the launcher wires into an instance bin
